We need to count aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is implicit? The system likely has a sample molecule loaded. We need to get its structure. Could use carbon_nmr_spectra to infer aromatic carbons? But easier: maybe there is a default sample? Not sure.

We can try to get carbon NMR spectra; aromatic carbons appear around 120-150 ppm. Count peaks in that region. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
